page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.16-64 is a flexible compute instance featuring dedicated x86_64 architecture processors. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9J45 processor running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz, this instance is configured with 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation is set at 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 2 GB per vCPU ratio (1:2 ratio relative to vCPUs, or 4 GB per physical core). Hardware acceleration instructions include extensive vector support such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16, alongside AES and SHA cryptographic acceleration.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier single-core and multi-core computational throughput. The instance scored 2,594.0 in single-core and 23,025.0 in multi-core Geekbench assessments. Cryptographic operations and compression workloads perform exceptionally well, marked by 38.01 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and 16.84 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Large-block uncached memory write throughput registers in the upper quartile at 108.74 GB/sec, while read-only cached bandwidth reaches 3339.97 GB/sec.

Workload evaluation reveals superior metrics for web delivery, compiling tasks, and lightweight machine learning inference. Static web serving throughput reaches 94.79 GB/sec, placing it in the top decile. In small-scale AI model inference (135M parameters), text generation hits 432.83 tokens/sec. The instance includes 1 complimentary public IPv4 address, but provides no integrated local NVMe storage and lacks discrete GPU hardware. Network storage must be attached separately for persistent data operations.

This hardware profile delivers efficient compute-heavy throughput where moderate memory capacity is sufficient. VM.Standard.E6.Flex.16-64 is well suited for continuous integration build systems, high-concurrency static web serving, software compilation pipelines, batch compression, and medium-scale LLM inference workloads.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.16-64 is a compute instance configured with 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs on an AMD EPYC 9J45 x86_64 processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, accompanied by 64.0 GB of memory. It features dedicated CPU allocation and rich vector acceleration extensions including AVX-512 and BF16. The instance does not include integrated local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on remote block storage for persistent data, and comes with 1 complimentary public IPv4 address. Benchmarks exhibit top-tier single-core performance, strong software compilation speed, and outstanding static web serving throughput of 94.79 GB/sec. Memory write throughput reaches 108.74 GB/sec on large blocks, complemented by top-tier compression results. With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this configuration represents an efficient architecture suited for CI/CD pipelines, code compilation, static web infrastructure, and CPU-based lightweight AI model inference.
